semantic_changes: Resolve a dashboard launch by explicit run or stable current-session identity and fail closed instead of guessing by project cwd when ambiguous.
Return and render only non-closed runs in the interactive run inventory, grouped by normalized project and labeled with the real root task title plus session/run identity.
Make the run chooser span the available header width and preserve accessible desktop and mobile interaction.
Version, document, independently review, publish, install, restart, and attest the exact approved correction without notifying other Codex tasks.
Do not delete, merge, close, re-key, rename, or mutate historical or active run records as part of this source repair.
Do not infer the current run from project name alone when multiple active runs share a cwd or project.
Do not expose closed historical runs in the interactive picker, auto-select an unrelated run, weaken review/release enforcement, expose secrets, or notify other Codex tasks.

invariants: Existing ledger history remains byte-preserved; filtering is a read/display concern rather than destructive cleanup.
A run-specific dashboard URL always opens that exact active run or shows a truthful unavailable state; it never silently falls back to another run.
Distinct active tasks in one project remain distinct, while the selector groups them under one project heading.
Health, explicit HTTP error behavior, foreign-listener preservation, production-goal review, signed release verification, and rollback remain fail closed.
No other Codex task is messaged or awakened after remediation.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Opening a dashboard URL bound to an active run or its root session renders that exact run.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: The dashboard must not guess another run from cwd, latest timestamp, project label, or historical inventory.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: A Codex task opening Plotkeeper in its own sidebar.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The chooser contains only active runs, grouped by project, with distinct real task labels and session/run identity.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Closed history, hundreds of duplicate project-only labels, or an ungrouped narrow list may not appear.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: A user inspecting the Plotkeeper run chooser on desktop or mobile.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The exact reviewed candidate is public, installed, and serving the corrected behavior.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: No stale source, install, release pointer, tag, process, or unsigned candidate may be reported as deployed.

known_discrepancies: The live ledger contains 263 accumulated runs, including closed history; the current /api/runs endpoint returns all of them.
Run labels currently use only Path(cwd).name, producing indistinguishable project-name duplicates.
The dashboard currently auto-selects the first active-looking row and current --cwd selects the newest cwd match, neither of which proves task identity.
Three MoonMarket-owned contract files were hash-preserved and relocated from Plotkeeper into Z:/MoonMarket/runtime/goal-contracts under explicit user authority before this contract.
